caption: The worked example drawn out: 4800 px² of overlap over 11,200 px² of union gives IoU 0.43, a weak match. Then NMS at threshold 0.5 keeps the 0.90 box and deletes the 0.85 box, because their IoU of 0.6 is above the threshold.

spec.title: IoU and NMS, worked example
spec.aria: Flowchart of the worked example: predicted box (30,40,110,140) and ground truth (50,60,130,160), each 8000 px², give an intersection of 4800 px² and a union of 11,200 px², so IoU is 0.4286; separately, two car boxes scoring 0.90 and 0.85 with IoU 0.6 go through NMS, which keeps the 0.90 box and deletes the 0.85 box because 0.6 is above the 0.5 threshold.
